column3: Well... I have to work "today", but...
Yes, so... Do I really have to spell it out for you?
Well, you did say that earlier.
Y-You see... While I'm busy today, I have some time off next week.
It's summer vacation after all, so it's nice to get some time off.
Hmm... I see. You've got time off next week.
You coming over to see Kirino?
A-Anyway! U-Um... Are you free next Saturday, Onii-san?
I am! I'm totally free! I have no plans other than breathing!
Y-You don't have to shout like that...
A-Anyway, why this all of a sudden? Something happened?
Well then... could you meet up with me?
Um... I wanted to thank you... Would you mind?
But you don't really need to thank me.
I did what I did because I wanted to.
I see... I guess you can't then.
N-N-N-No! That's not it at all! I'll go! I'll definitely go!
I'm looking forward to the date, Ayase.
I'm looking forward to the date, Ayase.
Please don't say such weird things. It's disgusting.
